name: u27-migrate-read-back
about: Migrate a store: import every record (the initial load is the import; run with --seed-from on a clone for the real records) and read every record back once on day 1 (the engine compares each value with the imported one, the digest check). Synthetic shape = the second account's own records: execution 11,212 (777 B), resource-command-result 10,964 (322 B), trigger-dispatch-outcome 1,909 (186 B), other kinds 178 (mean 600 B) [S o26]. Founder: 2,398,695 records, 178 kinds [S o03]. Sources: [A] 04-every-table-challenged.md; [P] clone queries on o08/o21/o27/o04/o07/o09 (profile-overhead lane, 2026-10-27); [L] clone queries o03 record_log 2026-10-20..22 PDT, o04 namespace_names, o21 account_control_permits operations (4 load days 2026-10-15..23); [S] --seed-from profile: founder o03 2,398,695 current records / 178 kinds, second account o26 24,263 records. Typical sizes come from the second account [S o26] where the kind exists there, else the founder [S o03].
